description: The rules of a recording's dataQuality entry that JSON Schema cannot state. For each case, run the record checks on entry, the entry of the recipe recipe, and compare the findings with expected: each {word, at}, at a slash path inside the entry, metrics first, then views, then views_skipped, in document order; an empty list passes.
